attributes.name: repeating_spell-cantrip_-MMBNR5tTHZShIXzZkpI_spelldescription
attributes.current: You touch a living creature that has 0 hit points. The creature becomes stable. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs.

attributes.name: repeating_spell-cantrip_-MMBOgmdrWe0vmn0vTZt_spelldescription
attributes.current:
You point at one creature you can see within range, and the sound of a dolorous bell fills the air around it for a moment. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or take 1d8 necrotic damage. If the target is missing any of its hit points, it instead takes 1d12 necrotic damage.
The spell's damage increases by one die when you reach 5th level (2d8 or 2d12), 11th level (3d8 or 3d12), and 17th level (4d8 or 4d12).

attributes.name: repeating_spell-cantrip_-MMBPSTlcRBFeJ8Z1Doj_spelldescription
attributes.current: You touch one willing creature. Once before the spell ends, the target can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to one ability check of its choice. It can roll the die before or after making the ability check. The spell then ends.

attributes.name: repeating_spell-cantrip_-MMBPhyCq5ckWhtdXvQN_spelldescription
attributes.current:
You utter a divine word, and burning radiance erupts from you. Each creature of your choice that you can see within range must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take 1d6 radiant damage.
The spell's damage increases by 1d6 when you reach 5th level (2d6), 11th level (3d6), and 17th level (4d6).

attributes.name: repeating_traits_-MMBQWT55FSRRy4NVSob_description
attributes.current:
You have practiced casting spells in the midst of combat, learning techniques that grant you the following benefits:
You have advantage on Constitution saving throws that you make to maintain your concentration on a spell when you take damage.
You can perform the somatic components of spells even when you have weapons or a shield in one or both hands.
When a hostile creature's movement provokes an opportunity attack from you, you can use your reaction to cast a spell at the creature, rather than making an opportunity attack. The spell must have a casting time of 1 action and must target only that creature.

attributes.name: repeating_spell-1_-MMBQq1JxhUk-O2A3IOP_spelldescription
attributes.current: A creature of your choice that you can see within range regains hit points equal to 1d4 + your spellcasting ability modifier. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs.

attributes.name: repeating_spell-1_-MMBScuPFtSiLdA9zSnc_spelldescription
attributes.current: Make a melee spell attack against a creature you can reach. On a hit, the target takes 3d10 necrotic damage.

attributes.name: repeating_spell-1_-MMBScuPFtSiLdA9zSnc_spellathigherlevels
attributes.current: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d10 for each slot level above 1st.

attributes.name: repeating_spell-1_-MMBTDJZswE3V7H4eGlJ_spelldescription
attributes.current: A creature you touch regains a number of hit points equal to 1d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs.

attributes.name: repeating_spell-1_-MMBTDJZswE3V7H4eGlJ_spellathigherlevels
attributes.current: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the healing increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 1st.

attributes.name: repeating_spell-1_-MMBTpKWAx6NFNzRhr3L_spelldescription
attributes.current:
You speak a one-word command to a creature you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or follow the command on its next turn. The spell has no effect if the target is undead, if it doesn't understand your language, or if your command is directly harmful to it.

Some typical commands and their effects follow. You might issue a command other than one described here. If you do so, the DM determines how the target behaves. If the target can't follow your command, the spell ends.

Approach. The target moves toward you by the shortest and most direct route, ending its turn if it moves within 5 feet of you.
Drop. The target drops whatever it is holding and then ends its turn.
Flee. The target spends its turn moving away from you by the fastest available means.
Grovel. The target falls prone and then ends its turn.
Halt. The target doesn't move and takes no actions. A flying creature stays aloft, provided that it is able to do so. If it must move to stay aloft, it flies the minimum distance needed to remain in the air.

attributes.name: repeating_spell-1_-MMBTpKWAx6NFNzRhr3L_spellathigherlevels
attributes.current: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, you can affect one additional creature for each slot level above 1st. The creatures must be within 30 feet of each other when you target them.

attributes.name: repeating_spell-1_-MMBUwEC0PApj2XnNDH9_spelldescription
attributes.current: A flash of light streaks toward a creature of your choice within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 4d6 radiant damage, and the next attack roll made against this target before the end of your next turn has advantage, thanks to the mystical dim light glittering on the target until then.

attributes.name: repeating_spell-1_-MMBUwEC0PApj2XnNDH9_spellathigherlevels
attributes.current: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 1st.

attributes.name: repeating_spell-2_-MMBYPPJBOLUYWPEySju_spellcomp_materials
attributes.current: a pair of platinum rings worth 50 gp each

attributes.name: repeating_spell-2_-MMBYPPJBOLUYWPEySju_spelldescription
attributes.current:
This spell wards a willing creature you touch and creates a mystic connection between you and the target until the spell ends. While the target is within 60 feet of you, it gains a +1 bonus to AC and saving throws, and it has resistance to all damage. Also, each time it takes damage, you take the same amount of damage.

The spell ends if you drop to 0 hit points or if you and the target become separated by more than 60 feet. It also ends if the spell is cast again on either of the connected creatures. You can also dismiss the spell as an action.

attributes.name: repeating_spell-2_-MMBYnLUfIDsrJVfnGmO_spelldescription
attributes.current: For the duration, no sound can be created within or pass through a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you choose within range. Any creature or object entirely inside the sphere is immune to thunder damage, and creatures are deafened while entirely inside it. Casting a spell that includes a verbal component is impossible there.

attributes.name: repeating_spell-2_-MMBZ5iwUFXd1Yb7z9Ux_spelldescription
attributes.current: Choose a humanoid that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be paralyzed for the duration. At the end of each of its turns, the target can make another Wisdom saving throw. On a success, the spell ends on the target.

attributes.name: repeating_spell-2_-MMBZ5iwUFXd1Yb7z9Ux_spellathigherlevels
attributes.current: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you can target one additional humanoid for each slot level above 2nd. The humanoids must be within 30 feet of each other when you target them.

attributes.name: repeating_spell-2_-MMBZOsJUOx2906784Xs_spelldescription
attributes.current:
You create a floating, spectral weapon within range that lasts for the duration or until you cast this spell again. When you cast the spell, you can make a melee spell attack against a creature within 5 feet of the weapon. On a hit, the target takes force damage equal to 1d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier.

As a bonus action on your turn, you can move the weapon up to 20 feet and repeat the attack against a creature within 5 feet of it.

The weapon can take whatever form you choose. Clerics of deities who are associated with a particular weapon (as St. Cuthbert is known for his mace and Thor for his hammer) make this spell's effect resemble that weapon.

attributes.name: repeating_spell-2_-MMBZOsJUOx2906784Xs_spellathigherlevels
attributes.current: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for every two slot levels above 2nd.

attributes.name: repeating_spell-1_-MMBZpCFLsBUEyZ2FWAQ_spellcomp_materials
attributes.current: a small parchment with holy text

attributes.name: repeating_spell-1_-MMBZpCFLsBUEyZ2FWAQ_spelldescription
attributes.current: A shimmering field appears and surrounds a creature of your choice within range, granting it a +2 bonus to AC for the duration.

attributes.name: repeating_spell-1_-MMBZG7CFog6O8dMlJaq_spelldescription
attributes.current: Your prayer empowers you with divine radiance. Until the spell ends, your weapon attacks deal an extra 1d4 radiant damage on a hit.

attributes.name: repeating_spell-2_-MMBZZn1ZD08vDrUJour_spelldescription
attributes.current: You touch a nonmagical weapon. Until the spell ends, that weapon becomes a magic weapon with a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls.

attributes.name: repeating_spell-2_-MMBZZn1ZD08vDrUJour_spellathigherlevels
attributes.current: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the bonus increases to +2. When you use a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the bonus increases to +3.

attributes.name: repeating_traits_-MN9V8yly3yFe6-GvWyd_description
attributes.current: From 1st level, your god delivers bolts of inspiration to you while you are engaged in battle. When you use the Attack action, you can make one weapon attack as a bonus action. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (a minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

attributes.name: repeating_inventory_-MNSgV2fJ171nlXYsZub_itemname
attributes.current: Dark common clothes with a hood

attributes.name: personality_traits
attributes.current: I am incredibly slow to trust. Those who seem the fairest often have the most to hide.

attributes.name: ideals
attributes.current: Freedom. Chains are meant to be broken, as are those who would forge them.

attributes.name: bonds
attributes.current: Something important was taken from me, and I aim to steal it back.

attributes.name: flaws
attributes.current: When faced with a choice between money and my friends, I usually choose the money.

attributes.name: repeating_spell-3_-MNihYfzaEbZTbMtpLIu_spelldescription
attributes.current:
You call forth spirits to protect you. They flit around you to a distance of 15 feet for the duration. If you are good or neutral, their spectral form appears angelic or fey (your choice). If you are evil, they appear fiendish.

When you cast this spell, you can designate any number of creatures you can see to be unaffected by it. An affected creature's speed is halved in the area, and when the creature enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 3d8 radiant damage (if you are good or neutral) or 3d8 necrotic damage (if you are evil). On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage.

attributes.name: repeating_spell-3_-MNihYfzaEbZTbMtpLIu_spellathigherlevels
attributes.current: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 3rd.

attributes.name: repeating_spell-3_-MNiibLolkHPlhrOPHRu_spellcomp_materials
attributes.current: Diamonds worth 300gp which the spell consumes

attributes.name: repeating_spell-3_-MNiibLolkHPlhrOPHRu_spelldescription
attributes.current: You touch a creature that has died within the last minute. That creature returns to life with 1 hit point. This spell can't return to life a creature that has died of old age, nor can it restore any missing body parts.

attributes.name: repeating_spell-3_-MNtRwcEHWGPw3mQEUBO_spelldescription
attributes.current: Holy power radiates from you in an aura with a 30-foot radius, awakening boldness in friendly creatures. Until the spell ends, the aura moves with you, centered on you. While in the aura, each nonhostile creature in the aura (including you) deals an extra 1d4 radiant damage when it hits with a weapon attack.

attributes.name: repeating_spell-3_-MNtTn7xIDTpmZGUk4sK_spelldescription
attributes.current: You sacrifice some of your health to mend another creature's injuries. You take 4d8 necrotic damage, which can't be reduced in any way, and one creature of your choice that you can see within range regains a number of hit points equal to twice the necrotic damage you take.

attributes.name: repeating_spell-3_-MNtTn7xIDTpmZGUk4sK_spellathigherlevels
attributes.current: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 3rd.

attributes.name: repeating_spell-3_-MNtULvalJUy7AaDZyMG_spelldescription
attributes.current: As you call out words of restoration, up to six creatures of your choice that you can see within range regain hit points equal to 1d4 + your spellcasting ability modifier. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs.

attributes.name: repeating_spell-3_-MNtULvalJUy7AaDZyMG_spellathigherlevels
attributes.current: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the healing increases by 1d4 for each slot level above 3rd.
